    <h2>{`When to Use Advanced Configuration`}</h2>
    <p>{`Use this advanced approach when:`}</p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">{`❌ QBE filtering cannot express your filtering logic`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`❌ You need to load ALL records from a datasource`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`❌ You need complex calculations across multiple fields`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`❌ You need custom aggregations or computations`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ You’re willing to manage memory carefully`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`✅ You understand the performance implications`}</li>
    </ul>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Important:`}</strong>{` This approach loads more data into memory. Always test on actual mobile devices to ensure acceptable performance.`}</p>
    <h2>{`Implementation`}</h2>
    <h3>{`Step 1: Add datasource to allowedAllRecordsLoadDS array`}</h3>
    <p>{`In your DataController, maintain an array of datasource IDs that are allowed to load all records. This is a safety mechanism to prevent accidentally loading too much data.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`DataController.js:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  
  /**
   * Datasources allowed to load all records
   * Add datasource IDs here that need full dataset for computation
   */
  allowedAllRecordsLoadDS = [
    'todaywoassignedDS',
    'reservationsListDS',
    'reservationsList4TransDS',
    'countBookListDS'
  ];
  
  onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
    this.datasource = datasource;
    this.app = app;
  }
  
  // Additional methods will be added in next steps
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Points:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`allowedAllRecordsLoadDS`}</inlineCode>{`: Array of datasource IDs that can load all records`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Only datasources in this array will bypass page-size limitations`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`This prevents accidental memory issues from loading too much data`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Step 2: Create maximo-datasource with mobile-shared-data-from`}</h3>
    <p>{`Create the maximo-datasource that shares data from another app. This datasource will load all records for processing.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`app.xml:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<maximo-datasource 
  id="todaywoassignedDS" 
  object-structure="mxapiwodetail" 
  saved-query="ASSIGNEDWOLIST" 
  mobile-qbe-filter="{{'status_maxvalue': '!=COMP,CAN,CLOSE,WAPPR', 'hidewo': '!=HIDE'}}" 
  order-by="wopriority" 
  selection-mode="none" 
  offline-immediate-download="true" 
  pre-load="true" 
  page-size="50" 
  controller="DataController" 
  include-counts="true">
  
  <schema id="gjw7p">
    <attribute name="wonum" searchable="true" id="g4dk9"/>
    <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="ej423"/>
    <attribute name="status_maxvalue" index="true" id="v68e9"/>
    <attribute name="wopriority" searchable="true" id="x3nyj"/>
    <attribute name="schedfinish" filterable="true" id="d23z7"/>
    <attribute name="workorderid" unique-id="true" id="gzwj2"/>
    <attribute name="siteid" searchable="true" id="n9ryw"/>
  </schema>
  
  <!-- Share data from Technician app -->
  <mobile-shared-data-from app-id="techmobile" datasource-id="todaywoassignedDS" id="link1"/>
</maximo-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <h3>{`Step 3: Create JSON datasource for computed values`}</h3>
    <p>{`Create a JSON datasource to hold the computed values that will be displayed in the tile.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`app.xml:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-xml"
      }}>{`<json-datasource 
  id="todaywoassignedDS_json" 
  src="{[]}" 
  controller="DataController" 
  selection-mode="none" 
  page-size="50">
  
  <schema id="gjw7p_JSON">
    <attribute name="wonum" searchable="true" id="g4dk9_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="description" searchable="true" id="ej423_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="status_maxvalue" index="true" id="v68e9_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="wopriority" searchable="true" id="x3nyj_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="schedfinish" filterable="true" id="d23z7_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="workorderid" unique-id="true" id="gzwj2_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="computedIsOverDue" title="computedIsOverDue" 
               remarks="computedIsOverDue" id="bzz5w_JSON"/>
    <attribute name="computedTotalRecords" title="Total Records" 
               remarks="Total record count" id="ctr01_JSON"/>
  </schema>
</json-datasource>
`}</code></pre>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Key Points:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul"><inlineCode parentName="li">{`src="{[]}"`}</inlineCode>{`: Starts with empty array, will be populated by DataController`}</li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Includes computed attributes like `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`computedIsOverDue`}</inlineCode>{` and `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`computedTotalRecords`}</inlineCode></li>
      <li parentName="ul">{`Schema matches maximo-datasource but adds computed fields`}</li>
    </ul>
    <h3>{`Step 4: Implement DataController logic`}</h3>
    <p>{`Implement the DataController to load all records, perform computations, and populate the JSON datasource.`}</p>
    <p><strong parentName="p">{`DataController.js:`}</strong></p>
    <pre><code parentName="pre" {...{
        "className": "language-js"
      }}>{`class DataController {
  
  /**
   * Datasources allowed to load all records
   */
  allowedAllRecordsLoadDS = [
    'todaywoassignedDS',
    'reservationsListDS',
    'reservationsList4TransDS',
    'countBookListDS'
  ];
  
  onDatasourceInitialized(datasource, owner, app) {
    this.datasource = datasource;
    this.app = app;
  }
  
  /**
   * Called after datasource loads data
   * This is where we process all records and compute values
   */
  async onAfterLoadData(datasource, items) {
    // Only process if this datasource is in allowed list
    if (!this.allowedAllRecordsLoadDS.includes(datasource.name)) {
      return items;
    }
    
    // Load ALL records if datasource is allowed
    await this.loadAllRecords(datasource);
    
    // Get all items after loading
    const allItems = datasource.items || [];
    
    // Perform computations
    const computedData = this.computeValues(allItems, datasource.name);
    
    // Update corresponding JSON datasource
    await this.updateJsonDatasource(datasource.name, computedData);
    
    return items;
  }
  
  /**
   * Load all records from datasource
   * Bypasses page-size limitation for datasources in allowedAllRecordsLoadDS
   */
  async loadAllRecords(datasource) {
    try {
      // Check if more records available
      while (datasource.state.hasMore) {
        const currentCount = datasource.items.length;
        const pageSize = datasource.state.pageSize || 50;
        
        // Load next page
        await datasource.loadRange(
          currentCount,
          pageSize,
          datasource.options?.query
        );
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(\`Error loading all records for \${datasource.name}:\`, error);
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Compute values based on all loaded records
   */
  computeValues(items, datasourceName) {
    const result = {
      computedTotalRecords: items.length,
      computedIsOverDue: 0
    };
    
    // Example: Count overdue work orders
    if (datasourceName === 'todaywoassignedDS') {
      const now = new Date();
      result.computedIsOverDue = items.filter(item => {
        if (item.schedfinish) {
          const schedFinish = new Date(item.schedfinish);
          return schedFinish < now && 
                 item.status_maxvalue !== 'COMP' && 
                 item.status_maxvalue !== 'CLOSE';
        }
        return false;
      }).length;
    }
    
    // Example: Count due and overdue reservations
    if (datasourceName === 'reservationsListDS' || 
        datasourceName === 'reservationsList4TransDS') {
      const now = new Date();
      let dueCount = 0;
      let overdueCount = 0;
      
      items.forEach(item => {
        if (item.requireddate) {
          const requiredDate = new Date(item.requireddate);
          if (requiredDate < now) {
            overdueCount++;
          } else {
            dueCount++;
          }
        }
      });
      
      result.computedDue = dueCount;
      result.computedOverDue = overdueCount;
    }
    
    // Example: Count books due for cycle count
    if (datasourceName === 'countBookListDS') {
      result.computedCountedDue = items.filter(item => {
        return item.status_maxvalue !== 'COMP';
      }).length;
    }
    
    return result;
  }
  
  /**
   * Update JSON datasource with computed values
   */
  async updateJsonDatasource(datasourceName, computedData) {
    const jsonDsName = \`\${datasourceName}_json\`;
    const jsonDs = this.app.findDatasource(jsonDsName);
    
    if (jsonDs) {
      // Clear existing data
      await jsonDs.clearState();
      
      // Add computed data as single item
      await jsonDs.load({ src: [computedData] });
    }
  }
  
  /**
   * Computed function for total records
   * Can be called from schema computed-function attribute
   */
  computedTotalRecords(item, datasource) {
    return datasource?.items?.length || 0;
  }
}

export default DataController;
`}</code></pre>

    <p><strong parentName="p">{`Common Issues:`}</strong></p>
    <ul>
      <li parentName="ul">
        <p parentName="li"><strong parentName="p">{`Issue:`}</strong>{` Tiles show 0 or incorrect values`}</p>
        <ul parentName="li">
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Cause:`}</strong>{` DataController not processing data correctly`}</li>
          <li parentName="ul"><strong parentName="li">{`Solution:`}</strong>{` Add logging to `}<inlineCode parentName="li">{`computeValues`}</inlineCode>{` method, verify logic`}</li>
        </ul>
